hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); MSG=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.message'); TITLE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.title'); CWD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.cwd // empty'); PROJECT=$(basename "$CWD"); TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%H:%M:%S"); $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/bin/terminal-notifier -message "$MSG" -title "$TITLE [$PROJECT] $TIMESTAMP" -sound Purr -contentImage "$HOME/.claude/user-defined/claudecode-icon.png" -activate "com.microsoft.VSCode"

INPUT=$(cat); MSG=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.message // .question // "入力待ちです"'); TITLE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.title // "❓⏳"'); CWD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.cwd // empty'); PROJECT=$(basename "$CWD"); TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%H:%M:%S"); $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/bin/terminal-notifier -message "$MSG" -title "$TITLE [$PROJECT] $TIMESTAMP" -sound Purr -contentImage "$HOME/.claude/user-defined/claudecode-icon.png" -activate "com.microsoft.VSCode"

INPUT=$(cat); Q=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.questions[0].question // "入力待ちです"' | head -c 120); CWD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.cwd // empty'); PROJECT=$(basename "$CWD"); TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%H:%M:%S"); $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/bin/terminal-notifier -message "$Q" -title "❓⏳ [$PROJECT] $TIMESTAMP" -sound Purr -contentImage "$HOME/.claude/user-defined/claudecode-icon.png" -activate "com.microsoft.VSCode"

INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | head -c 120); CWD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.cwd // empty'); PROJECT=$(basename "$CWD"); TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%H:%M:%S"); $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/bin/terminal-notifier -message "$ $CMD" -title "👾⏳ [$PROJECT] $TIMESTAMP" -sound Purr -contentImage "$HOME/.claude/user-defined/claudecode-icon.png" -activate "com.microsoft.VSCode"

INPUT=$(cat); TOOL=$(echo "$INPUT" | sed -nE 's/.*"tool_name"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([^"]*)".*/\1/p' | head -1); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | sed -nE 's/.*"(file_path|notebook_path)"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([^"]*)".*/\2/p' | head -1 | head -c 200); CWD=$(echo "$INPUT" | sed -nE 's/.*"cwd"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([^"]*)".*/\1/p' | head -1); case "$TOOL" in Write) ICON="✚";; *) ICON="✏️";; esac; case "$FILE" in "$CWD"/*) DISPLAY="./${FILE#$CWD/}";; *) DISPLAY="$FILE";; esac; PROJECT=$(basename "$CWD"); TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%H:%M:%S"); $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/bin/terminal-notifier -message "$ICON $DISPLAY" -title "📝⏳ [$PROJECT] $TIMESTAMP" -sound Purr -contentImage "$HOME/.claude/user-defined/claudecode-icon.png" -activate "com.microsoft.VSCode"

INPUT=$(cat); URL=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.url // empty' | head -c 200); CWD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.cwd // empty'); PROJECT=$(basename "$CWD"); TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%H:%M:%S"); $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/bin/terminal-notifier -message "$URL" -title "🔎⏳ [$PROJECT] $TIMESTAMP" -sound Purr -contentImage "$HOME/.claude/user-defined/claudecode-icon.png" -activate "com.microsoft.VSCode"

INPUT=$(cat); CWD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.cwd // empty'); PROJECT=$(basename "$CWD"); TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%H:%M:%S"); $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/bin/terminal-notifier -message "プラン承認待ち" -title "📋⏳ [$PROJECT] $TIMESTAMP" -sound Purr -contentImage "$HOME/.claude/user-defined/claudecode-icon.png" -activate "com.microsoft.VSCode"

INPUT=$(cat); TRANSCRIPT=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty'); CWD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.cwd // empty'); PROJECT=""; [ -n "$CWD" ] && PROJECT=$(basename "$CWD"); TITLE_SHORT=""; if [ -n "$TRANSCRIPT" ] && [ -f "$TRANSCRIPT" ]; then TITLE=$(jq -rs '[.[] | select(.type=="user") | .message.content[]? | select(.type=="text" and (.text|startswith("<")|not)) | .text] | last // empty' "$TRANSCRIPT" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' | head -1); TITLE_SHORT=$(printf '%s' "$TITLE" | tr -s '[:space:]' '\n' | head -8 | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/[[:space:]]*$//'); fi; MSG="${TITLE_SHORT:-Completed!}"; TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%H:%M:%S"); $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/bin/terminal-notifier -message "$MSG" -title "✅ [$PROJECT] $TIMESTAMP" -sound Purr -activate "com.microsoft.VSCode" -contentImage "$HOME/.claude/user-defined/claudecode-icon.png"
